name: D4LA: Diverse Document Layout Analysis Benchmark
description: D4LA (Diverse Document Layout Analysis) is a benchmark dataset for fine-grained document layout analysis introduced alongside the Vision Grid Transformer (VGT) architecture by Alibaba DAMO Academy at ICCV 2023. Derived from the IIT-CDIP Test Collection, D4LA comprises 11,092 high-resolution document pages representing 12 diverse business and technical document types (including letters, memos, invoices, forms, scientific reports, and advertisements). The dataset establishes 27 detailed layout element categories (such as document title, section title, paragraph, list, table, figure, caption, header, footer, code, equation, and stamp), bridging the gap between coarse-grained document layout datasets and real-world industrial visually rich document applications.

license.notes: Code in the AlibabaResearch/AdvancedLiterateMachinery repository is released under Apache-2.0. The D4LA dataset distributed on ModelScope does not specify an explicit dataset-level open license or commercial reuse grant. Document images are sampled from the IIT-CDIP collection and downstream commercial usage permissions remain unverified.

source_references.title: Vision Grid Transformer for Document Layout Analysis (ICCV 2023)

verification.notes: Verified against Alibaba DAMO Academy ModelScope repository iic/D4LA, AdvancedLiterateMachinery codebase, and ICCV 2023 proceedings (DOI: 10.1109/ICCV51070.2023.01783). Confirmed 11,092 document pages (8,868 train, 2,224 test), 27 layout categories, verified citation authors (Cheng Da, Chuwei Luo, Qi Zheng, Cong Yao), and direct lineage to IIT-CDIP. Apache-2.0 applies to software; dataset licensing is unspecified by source with unknown commercial rights.

size.notes: Official ModelScope release containing high-resolution JPEG document scans and COCO-format JSON layout annotations.
